profile.headline: Software Engineer at PayPal
profile.summary: Software Engineer at PayPal, focused on global solutions and product architecture. Inspired by the art of engineering – combining clean systems, AI-driven tooling, and close collaboration to build intuitive, high-impact experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wallet as a Service 💰: Building scalable, PayPal-licensed wallet platform solutions powering next-gen embedded wallet partnerships with enterprise partners.
Fastlane by PayPal 💳: Engineered core systems to expand Fastlane into 30 European and 5 Asian markets.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Claude Code · Cursor AI · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Costa Mesa, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed and enhanced Hyundai and Kia's Feature-On-Demand (FOD) management portal for business stakeholders, using TypeScript and Node/NestJS. 

Introduced best practices like Prettier and unit testing, while debugging and resolving real-world customer issues such as FOD product activation failures by understanding the business context and tracing root causes

Built and maintained new features for Hyundai and Kia's ECU OTA (Electronic Control Unit Over-The-Air) service backend system with NestJS and Angular. 

Improved developer experience by transitioning from ODBC to JDBC tools, while ensuring the application’s stability through regular maintenance and issue resolution.
positions.insights: Skills: NestJS · React.js · Node.js · AngularJS · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated day-to-day within an Agile methodology framework, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. 

Clients: The Walt Disney Studios and Sony Pictures Entertainment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Culver City, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Built a cloud-based digital asset registry that aggregated movie asset data from different sources and performed data normalization into a storage-friendly representation.

Enhanced system integration with AWS EventBridge for efficient event-driven architecture, and improved data analysis using OpenSearch.

Built reusable React components (dropdowns, accordions, and cards) to ensure UI consistency and scalability, and implemented React Hook Form for better user experience.

Optimized data presentation with custom filtering and sorting algorithms in AG Grid, and ensured UI reliability through comprehensive Jest test suites.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · React.js · Tailwind CSS · Node.js · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an internal content management system to facilitate the generation of
unique so-called ‘experiences’ to support a large scale cloud-based digital media distribution platform.

Implemented seamless schema management with Knex.js for smooth database migrations.

Established UI testing workflows using Cypress.io for reliable frontend validation.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React · Material UI · Node.js · Next.js · Apache Kafka · Docker · PostgreSQL

positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: PHP · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
